what: Glazed shell, flower, feather and scroll fittings for the façades, moulded on a buff body

what: Machine for raising water: wooden crank frame after Belidor (Val Saint Pierre), elm and sandalwood with copper and iron, mule- and man-driven; copper pump barrels 激筒; bitumen, cloth and rope seals where Belidor uses leather; TIN pipes 錫管 where Belidor has lead
locator: p.2413 Table 1; 《内庭圆明园内工诸作现行则例》, 《西洋水法铸造激筒铜管等项活计按例应用物料匠夫则例》
quote_or_basis: Abstract: used bitumen, cloth and rope, and tin pipes to substitute for lead pipes. So 'lead pipes' for the Xiyang Lou is unsupported; and 龙尾车 Archimedes screws are NOT what this paper reports: it treats a crank machine and piston pumps. Taixi shuifa of 1612 has the screw, but no one here says it was used.
